title: 第13章 徐师姐上门第14章 就怕魔女不魔
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 莫阳愣愣的看着太上长老，额头爬满了黑线……
心中更是无语到了极点，感情这老头一直在暗中监视他。
同时他心中也心惊，因为当时他压根就没察觉到异常，如若对方是敌人，对他来说后果不堪设想。
“老东西，你在暗中监视我？”莫阳冷眼看着太上长老。
“小子，你大半夜把菲儿骗到木峰上来，老夫还不能来看看？”太上长老当即瞪眼。
他接着冷哼道：“混账小子，别以为你表面装得人畜无害就能骗过老夫的眼睛，你每次吃完抹嘴就不认账，若是老夫再不上点心，她什么时候被你卖了都不知道！”
一旁的苏菲儿满脸羞怒的盯着太上长老看了一眼，随后直接转身冲出了小院。
看着苏菲儿一走，太上长老神色瞬间变了。
只见他压低声音开口道：“小子，你看到没，若是放在以前，她非得把老夫胡须扯下一半才罢休，但你看她现在，你见过她这般害羞的模样吗？菲儿肯定是喜欢上你了。”
“菲儿虽然性子略有些娇蛮，不过她本心善良单纯……”
“小子，你就是一个木鱼疙瘩，哪有肥肉送到嘴边不吃的理！”
“我去……老头，你是个狠人！”莫阳不知道还能说什么了。
他如今发现这老家伙居然这么不正经，居然如此奇葩。
“小子，老夫是为你好，过了这个村可就没这个店！”
太上长老干咳了几声，不过依旧脸不红心不跳的。
莫阳就这么默默看着，他心中很清楚太上长老这个老坑货想干什么。
无论这老家伙怎么弄，最终目的都是为了让他安心留在灵虚宗。
小样，还想用美女来诱惑我……
我是那种人吗？
“小子，扪心自问，你就一点不想吃？”
见莫阳一副局外人的模样，浑然不在意，老头话锋一转，语出惊人，直接开门见山。
“不想！”莫阳摇头。
“你……不开窍的玩意，气煞老夫！”太上长老气得咬牙，直接转身朝小院外走去。
莫阳沉吟片刻，开口道：“老头，你强留也没有用，灵虚宗所在地放在玄天大陆上不过是弹丸之地，大陆浩瀚无边，我终有一天要走出去，不可能一直停留在这里！”
“不过你放心，我莫阳并非忘恩负义之辈，师父从小教我要知恩感恩，这是我的本心所指！”
太上长老默默站在院门口，并未转身，嘴角浮起一丝笑意，不过似乎还是很不爽，接着冷哼了一声，直接走出了小院。
莫阳这才迫不及待的去仔细探查手中的纳戒，兴奋得差点大叫出来。
有很多药材都是炼制其他丹药的，珍贵的自然是那几株灵药，
“啧啧，这小妮子不错，知道哥哥药材用完了，都知道提前准备了……孺子可教也……不好好报答你，哥这心里都过意不去……”
莫阳砸着嘴巴自语了一番，心中兴奋无比，琢磨着等以后，必须得多给这丫头一些小药丸。
接下来了时间，莫阳一边炼丹一边开始参悟那些上古符文。
转眼便过去了半月。
content_en:
Mo Yang looked at the Supreme Elder blankly, his forehead covered with black lines...
He was extremely speechless in his heart. The old man Emotion had been spying on him secretly.
At the same time, he was also frightened because he didn't notice the abnormality at all at the time. If the other party was an enemy, the consequences would be disastrous for him.
"Old guy, are you spying on me?" Mo Yang looked at the Supreme Elder coldly.
"Boy, you tricked Fei'er into coming to Mufeng in the middle of the night. Why don't I come and take a look?" The elder Taishang immediately glared.
He then snorted coldly: "You bastard, don't think you can deceive me by pretending to be harmless. You wipe your mouth every time you eat and refuse to admit it. If I don't get some snacks, you won't even know when she was sold by you!"
Sophie on the side stared at the Supreme Elder with a face full of shame and anger, then turned around and rushed out of the small courtyard.
Seeing Sophie leave, the Supreme Elder's expression changed instantly.
He lowered his voice and said, "Boy, did you see that in the past, she would have had to pull off half of my beard to stop, but look at her now, have you ever seen her look so shy? Mayfair must have fallen in love with you."
"Although Fei'er has a bit of a delicate temperament, she is kind-hearted and simple..."
"Boy, you're just a wooden fish, there's no reason why you won't eat the fat that's put in your mouth!"
"I'll go...Old man, you are a cruel person!" Mo Yang didn't know what else to say.
He now discovered that this old guy was so crooked and weird.
"Boy, I'm doing this for your own good. There is no shop like this after passing this village!"
The Supreme Elder coughed a few times, but his face did not turn red and his heart did not beat.
Mo Yang just watched silently, he knew very well what the old swindler, the Supreme Elder, wanted to do.
No matter what this old guy does, the ultimate goal is to allow him to stay in Lingxu Sect with peace of mind.
Demo, you want to seduce me with beautiful women...
Am I that kind of person?
"Boy, ask yourself, do you not want to eat at all?"
Seeing that Mo Yang looked like an outsider and didn't care at all, the old man changed the subject, made a shocking statement, and went straight to the point.
"No!" Mo Yang shook his head.
"You... you are so ignorant, you are so angry with me!" The elder Taishang gritted his teeth in anger, turned around and walked out of the small courtyard.
Mo Yang pondered for a moment and then said: "Old man, it's useless for you to stay here. The location of Lingxu Sect is just a small place on the Xuantian Continent. The continent is vast and boundless. I will go out one day, and I can't stay here forever!"
"But don't worry, I, Mo Yang, am not an ungrateful person. My master taught me to be grateful since I was a child. This is my true intention!"
The Supreme Elder stood silently at the door of the courtyard without turning around. There was a smile on his lips, but he still seemed very unhappy. Then he snorted and walked out of the small courtyard.
Mo Yang couldn't wait to carefully examine the Najie in his hand, and he almost screamed with excitement.
There are many medicinal materials used to refine other elixirs, and the most precious ones are naturally those few elixirs.
"Tsk, tsk, this little girl is good. She knew that my brother had run out of medicinal materials, so she knew to prepare it in advance... Children can't be taught... If I don't repay you properly, I will feel bad..."
Mo Yang smacked his mouth and muttered to himself, feeling extremely excited, thinking that he would have to give this girl more pills in the future.
…
After a while, Mo Yang began to comprehend the ancient runes while refining the elixir.
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
